'''Helarin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served onboard the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Carrick Station]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Helarin appeared as a gear vendor in the video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', but was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
